Name: Skills Experience Bars
Author: Muuajizin
Description:
Experience Bars Mod for Stardew Valley

[b]Description:[/b]The Experience Bars Mod adds experience bars for Farmer's skills. This mod provides an easy way to monitor skill progression directly in the game.
[b]Features:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Toggle Button for Experience Bars:[/b] Adds a button, with the Farmer portrait, to the game's user interface. Players can click this button to display or hide the experience bars for their skills.
[*][b]Customizable Hotkey:[/b] The button can also be toggled using a customizable hotkey defined in the [code]config.json[/code]
file, providing flexibility and ease of access.
[*][b]Tooltip Display:[/b] A tooltip appears when hovering over the button, providing additional information about its functionality.
[*][b]Button Positioning:[/b] The button is responsible positioned relative to the game's UI scale settings to ensure a consistent and seamless user experience.
[/list][b]Configuration:[/b]
[list]
[*]The configuration file [code]config.json[/code] is located in the mod's folder and can be edited to change the default toggle key. By default, the toggle key is set to [code]F1[/code]
.[/list][b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of SMAPI (Stardew Modding API).
[*]Extract the mod files into the [code]Mods[/code]
folder located in the Stardew Valley game directory.
[*]Edit the [code]config.json[/code]
file if you wish to change the default toggle key.
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI to enable the mod.
[/list][b]Usage:[/b]
[list]
[*]Press the configured toggle key (default is F1) to show or hide the experience bars.
[*]Click the button to toggle the visibility of the experience bars.
[/list]
This mod enhances the player's experience by providing a quick and easy way to monitor skill progression, helping players stay informed about their development in the game.
